verdict.rationale: Qapita is a SaaS cap table and equity management platform, so publishing a machine-readable API spec is a fair question for it. The probe found no OpenAPI or Swagger document at any standard path, all returning 404. The llms.txt file is a marketing and product summary for LLMs, not an API specification, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
